headlines.title: Pennsylvania warns of rise in congenital measles and infection during pregnancy
headlines.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Health issued an alert to doctors about an increase in measles infections in pregnant women, as well as a concerning rise in congenital measles — a disease that’s rarely, if ever, seen in the U.S.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: How One Couple Found Resilience After SIDS Tragedy
headlines.description: Carl and Liz Buford are young parents who managed to find hope, healing and joy after dealing with the unimaginable loss of their third child Carlee to Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS). The Bufords join TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones with their three children to open up about how they built resilience through tragedy, received support through the nonprofit New Hope For Kids and more. headlines.title: Christina Applegate Says She Was Misdiagnosed With MS
headlines.description: For the last five years, Christina Applegate believed she had multiple sclerosis but now she says her doctor told her that she was misdiagnosed. The actor, who has been an outspoken advocate for MS research, said the news was "unnerving" and "confusing." NBC’s Emilie Ikeda reports and Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY to discuss what causes a misdiagnosis and how common it is.

headlines.title: Christina Applegate misdiagnosed with MS
headlines.description: A stunning revelation from actor Christina Applegate, who has been public about her battle with multiple sclerosis. She reveals her doctors told her she doesn't have the disease and was misdiagnosed. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda has more.

headlines.title: New gene therapy gives some kids born deaf the ability to hear
headlines.description: A new gene therapy is now giving some children born deaf the ability to hear. NBC’s Dr. Akshay Syal breaks down the remarkable breakthrough and the kind of hearing loss it can help treat.

headlines.title: How to prevent a dry, irritated nose this cold season
headlines.description: Ear, nose and throat doctors explain why your nose gets raw and irritated during a cold, how to prevent it and the products that can soothe your nostrils and septum.

headlines.title: This popular electric fabric shaver is 51% off just in time for sweater weather
headlines.description: Your next few months may be filled with lots of sweaters, keep them in good shape with this fabric shaver-lint roller that’s more than half off at Walmart today.

headlines.title: Worried about tech neck? These dermatologist-approved creams smooth fine lines
headlines.description: Dermatologists explain which ingredients help firm sagging neck skin and smooth fine lines. Discover the best neck creams and what to consider for your routine.

headlines.title: The best vacuum sealers to cut down on food waste
headlines.description: Vacuum sealers keep food fresh for longer and help prevent freezer burn. Food experts explain how to use them and what to look for, plus top-rated picks from Nesco, Anova and more.

headlines.title: Christina Applegate’s Health Journey, From Early MS Symptoms to Learning She was Misdiagnosed
headlines.description: Christina Applegate announced in Oct. 2026 that she was misdiagnosed with MS. The actor was diagnosed in 2021 and has long dealt with debilitating symptoms.
